title: setTaskbar v1
description: Harbor.Shell to dock, on the control channel: hide the Windows taskbar, or stop hiding it. Sent on every connect and whenever the user changes it. The dock hides only while its safety rules hold (see docs/adr/0007) and answers with taskbarState. Any change to this message bumps v.

hidden.description: true: hide the taskbar. false: show it and clear a panic or explorerFighting block.
